title: sempervivum tectorum subsp. boutignyanum
intro: Sempervivum tectorum subsp. boutignyanum, commonly known as the Jade Plant or Friendship Plant, is a popular succulent species of the genus Sempervivum. This plant is known for its rounded, plump leaves and is often used in traditional medicine due to its perceived health benefits, which include reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of the Jade Plant are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of the Sempervivum tectorum subsp. boutignyanum plant.
